mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trade_history (user_id, etf_id, trade_type, price, quantity, amount) VALUES (#{userId}, #{etfId}, #{tradeType}, #{price}, #{quantity}, #{amount})
mapper.select: SELECT t.trade_id AS tradeId, t.etf_id AS etfId, e.etf_name AS etfName, t.trade_type AS tradeType, t.price AS price, t.quantity AS quantity, t.amount AS amount, t.created_at AS createdAt FROM trade_history t INNER JOIN etf_product e ON t.etf_id = e.etf_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT trade_id, user_id, etf_id, trade_type, price, quantity, amount, created_at FROM trade_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(created_at) <= #{toDate} ORDER BY created_at
SELECT trade_id, user_id, etf_id, trade_type, price, quantity, amount, created_at FROM trade_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY created_at
